ExtTqp.comment: tqp from motor measurement instead from internal clock

SingleVolume.comment: Single volume acquisition (acq_stop will be set after one volume)

TrigFreeExtN.comment: true: produce internal triggersignal false: external determinated by ext_trg_src

TrigExtSrcSel.comment: false: extrenal trigger port, true: trigger from Z-motor control

AcqStop.comment: true: aquisition is stopped (default), false: aquisition is running

DoSeqRld.comment: trigger sequencer reloading, register is cleared when done

VolReady.comment: read only: indicates that a volume is ready for read out in the first mem

MemSoftRes.comment: true: forces the write statemachine of the AB memory to go to idle, false: normal mode

CalDur1Cyc.comment: true: Offsetcompensation takes 1 cycle, false: Offsetcompensation takes reg value

SensCfgBusy.comment: read only: indicates that configuration data is being downloaded and that camera should not be triggered

ExtTqpPuls.comment: true: External TQP pulses are generated on both channels, false: External TQP pulses are generated on one channel only

CalSurfWhileAcq.comment: 0: Normal acquisition mode (new measurement after results are transferred tohost) 1: high speed acquisition mode (new measurement while surface calculations are in process). Do not use ztags from header inthis case!

EnSBIS.comment: 0: No Sensor Built in Self test, 1: Sensor Built in Self test enabled -> electrical stimulation of sensor. sensor built in stimulus is not used for extTQP or intensity mode

DoBist.comment: trigger BIST, register is cleared when done. Make sure acquisition_stop=1 and no data remains to be fetched (DDR memory will be overwritten)

EnSynFOut.comment: 0: Disables synchronization signal on OUT3 (rectangular waveform with demodulation frequency fd, see appendix A2) 1: Enables synchronization signal on OUT3

OutEnDrv.comment: 0: Set OutEnDrv output to 0, 1: Set OutEnDrv output to 1 (Pin 5 on camera connector)

Out1.comment: 0: Set general purpose output Out1 to 0, 1:Set general purpose output to 1

EnSprOsc.comment: 0: Disable spread spectrum oscillator, 1: Enable spread spectrum oscillator

SoftRes.comment: hold FPGA in soft reset mode

PowerCtrl.comment: Power control: T120Deg: Length of one third of the synchronisation period for sensor board power regulators 200MHz system clock cycles

MskTrgOnPos.comment: 0: clear cnt from ext 1: mask clear cnt from ext

EnTrigOnPos.comment: 1: enabled or 0: disabled Trigger on Position feature

TrigOnPos.comment: Position (Encoder value) where a trigger is generated. Only active if ‘TrigOnPos’ feature is enabled

SensNavM2.comment: Number of averaging/demodulating cycles per frame: SensNavM2 x 2 + 2 (from symmetrical sequencer)

SensNFrames.comment: Number of demodulation images taken per acquisition

FrmDur35MHz.comment: Frame duration T Frame  between two consecutive frames. Value in 1/35Mhz sequencer clock cycles.

TDemodCyc35MHz.comment: Duration of a sensor demodulation cycle in 1/35MHz clock cycles.

SensDeltaExp.comment: Duration of a sensor demodulation cycle in 1/35MHz clock cycles.

LoadTestSeq.comment: Sets all data from sensor to zero

BSEnable.comment: true: Background suppression on, false: BS off

SensExpTimeMult.comment: Multiplier to calculate long exposure time for intensity mode. (LongExpTime = SensExpTime * ((SensExpTimeMult+1)*2))

SensExpRatio.comment: Dead time to comply with the frame rate.

SensNDarkFrames.comment: Number of dark frames for offset compensation. (SensNFrames-SensNDarkFrames) > 2

SensExpTime.comment: Short exposure time in intensity mode.

SensCaldur.comment: Number of sequencer cycles for the offsetcompensation, only if CalDur1Cyc = false

SigTsh.comment: Signal threshold, peak is considered as noise (simpleMax),Offsetmetric in header (#Ascans in +-SigTsh)

FWHMnFrame.comment: Full With Half Max of the signal envelope in frames, 000: 0, 001: 2, 010: 6, 011: 10, 100: 20

BiasI.comment: Bias value on I for the first two frames of the volume (10Bit)

BiasQ.comment: Bias value on Q for the first two frames of the volume (10Bit)

OffsetMethod.comment: 0: Offset determined by histogram method, 1:Offset determined by averaging

UseLastFrame.comment: 0: First frames are used in averaging mode, 1: Last frames are used in averaging mode

NFrmAvg.comment: Number of frames used for averaging nAvg = 2^(NFrmAvg) - 1

HistPixOut.comment: HistPixOut*8 = Allowed number of pixels outside the margin (+-SigTsh)

ExSimpMaxHwin.comment: Half window size in the extended simple max CamMode. The maximum half window size is 10 (default is 5), which results in a window size of 21.

EnFirstSurf.comment: Enable first surface detection, other surfaces in the volume will be ignored

EnMaxUnderTsh.comment: Enable max search under amplitude treshold active only if first surface enabled

EnDiffuseSurf.comment: Enable detection of first treshhold crossing e.g. for diffuse surfaces

EnLastSurf.comment: Enable clearing of results after consecutive crossing of treshhold value, last found surfface will be discarted and a new search begins

EnDeltaZ.comment: Enable finding the delta Z of two peaks in the ascan

LutCtrl.comment: 00: idle, 01: Start writing LUT  00:, 10: start reading LUT 00: finished reading LUT

EnergyLutData.comment: data wich is written or read to the energy function LUT

UndRelParam.comment: Under relaxation parameter for minimize energy algo u(0.8)

ZRangeStart.comment: Starting frame for energy function to be applied

ZRangeEnd.comment: Last frame where the energy function is applied taken

MinEnergWin.comment: Window for the minimize energy: Half range around the mean of the neighbors, limiting minimize energy. Value has to be a multiple of 8.

ObsAddr.comment: Address to select internal FPGA signals to be observed. Debugging feature.

ObsData.comment: Output for observed internal FPGA signals, live. (read-only, volatile register)

BistNum.comment: 0x10: Test ZTAG chain (encoder signals are generated internally. They emulate a motor with a 100nm encoder driving 5mm/s)

IterCtrl.comment: 0: both disabled, 1: int enabled frac disabled, 2: int disabled frac enabled, 3:int enabled frac enabled

IterMaxInt.comment: Maximum number of iterations done by the integer algorithm

IterMaxFrac.comment: Maximum number of fractional done by the integer algorithm

StatSens.comment: Go/NoGo for individual sensor quarters (read-onyl, volatile register)

StatMem.comment: Status register containing no real data up to no (read-only, volatile register)
